alerts.headline: Simon re-leases 1M SF of Saks space, projects rents rising from $18M to $44M
alerts.client_summary: Simon Property Group has absorbed the roughly 1 million SF vacated by Saks Off 5th bankruptcies while holding portfolio occupancy steady at 96%. The REIT has already replaced the $18M in lost Saks rent and expects new leases on the full block to generate $44M annually—a 144% increase. Initial base rent on new leases rose 17% year-over-year through Q2, with remaining space described as near final deals.

alerts.headline: Vornado/Related's 85 Tenth Ave faces imminent default on $625M debt stack

Despite 89.9% occupancy anchored by Google's 300K SF renewal, cash flow has run 28% below projections since the pandemic. The distress signals potential forced disposition or restructuring of a significant New York asset.

The property also carries $229M in mezzanine debt, bringing total encumbrances to $625M on the Google-anchored building. Special servicing status increases the likelihood of a negotiated restructuring or forced sale in the near term.

alerts.headline: Jamestown's Waterfront Plaza availability drops from 66% to 22% on AI demand

Well-amenitized, transit-accessible buildings near the Embarcadero are capturing the strongest leasing activity.
